verdict.rationale: Users control where data lives and when it goes away through their own resource management. Network volumes keep data independently of compute and retain it through terminate or scale-to-zero, Pods can be terminated, and files and volumes can be managed and removed via the S3-compatible API, CLI, or REST API. There is no documented retention policy, deletion guarantee, or data-purge control. Missing for 10: explicit data retention policies or configurable retention windows, documented deletion/wipe guarantees for pod disks and volumes, account/data deletion requests, logs/request data retention controls for Serverless and Public Endpoints, independent corroboration.
